#071 · Flycatcher Pokémon

Victreebel

Grass Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Victreebel is a Grass/Poison-type Flycatcher Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.7 m tall and weighs 15.5 kg. It evolves from Weepinbell. Its highest base stat is Attack (105), with a base stat total of 490.
